change: Capture inherited lexical binding metadata when a nested For collection directly references the same item name it shadows. Resolver reads that parent context by reference.
regressions: Real .ui parent/child reorder, removed parent, duplicate parent keys in fresh/cached maps now run with distinct and identical item names (12 cases).
Three consecutive For levels named item bind to deepest leaf.
Malformed cyclic parent metadata still boundedly refuses.
limitations: Owned lexical snapshots increase copying in shadowing cases; no performance bound claimed.
Nonadjacent shadowing, arbitrary lexical chains, computed/derived collections need further matrix.
